ageGate.title: First things first — how old are you?
ageGate.lead: vaporlog is a journal for adults who vaporize. Your birthday never leaves this device; it just keeps the door honest.

errors.invalidDate: That date doesn't look quite right — mind checking it?
errors.futureDate: That's in the future — nice try, time traveler.

ageGate.legalNote: vaporlog is for adults 21+ in jurisdictions where vaporization is legal.

blocked.title: This one's not for you — yet.
blocked.body: vaporlog is strictly for adults 21 and over, in places where vaporization is legal. No judgment, no lecture — we'll be right here when the time is right.
blocked.resetHint: Entered the wrong birthday by mistake? Clearing this site's data in your browser settings starts you over.

account.leadSignup: Pick a handle and a password. Your sessions stay private by default — if you ever publish one, only your handle shows.
account.leadSignin: Sign in with your handle and password to open your diary.
account.handleHintSignin: The handle you signed up with.
account.handleTaken: That handle is taken. <signin>Sign in with it instead</signin>
account.passwordHintSignup: {{min}} characters minimum. It's stored only as a hash — never in plain text.
account.passwordHintSignin: The password you chose when you signed up.
account.switchToSignin: Already have an account? Sign in
account.switchToSignup: New to vaporlog? Create an account

account.syncNote: your account syncs across your devices — sessions stay private by default
